errors.error_description: Declared a signal using an escaped identifier for the SystemVerilog keyword 'always_comb' (logic \always_comb), which misuses a reserved word as an identifier.
Declared 'unused_flag' but never read or driven anywhere in the module, creating an unused signal.
Assigned a 16-bit signal 'wide_sum' to an 8-bit output 'data_out' using a continuous assignment, causing silent truncation.
